answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a stake-backed web of trust. A newcomer comet must collect three vouchers from established agents guarding the harbor, each voucher locking a slashable deposit that is forfeited if that newcomer is exposed as fake. This tends the garden of honest identities: to mint k fake agents an attacker must corrupt k distinct stakers and pay a locked deposit for each, while a single detection slashes every backer, so cost scales with identities and quickly exceeds any capped reward.
